meta.amendment_20261003_ticket15: T_env_max reference moved from the single +-12 deg platform edge to the PER-MODE envelope edge (STR/SPT 45 deg, SLS 26.9 deg) after the Eq.(22) production switch. Measured 6.7178 s -> 10.5830 s (1.5754x), argmax SLS -> SPT. Keeping the 12 deg reference would under-normalise every C3/C4 value by that factor while the raw quantities were unchanged -- a unit drift, not a physics change. The C2 assembly, C3 weight ladder and C4 chain are UNCHANGED by this amendment.
meta.formula_registration: D09-5: the C2 assembly, the C3 weight ladder and the C4 chain are registered EXCLUSIVELY in this file (frozen); the frozen formula-spec is deliberately not extended for these implementation conventions. Freezing discipline follows the ticket-03 pad precedent: values + rule strings + date; retuning after any experiment has consumed them is a prereg violation.

ruling_records.D09-1_pad_object: The 25% inter-task pad multiplies the DWELL (dur_i), not the maneuver. Three sources: Kim 2021 original text x3 (p.11 'in addition to SAT obtained from Equations (19) or (24)', p.19 'the margin of sar sat is considered as 25%', p.25 '8.08-8.38 s (25% margin was considered)'); formula-spec v1.0.1 line 120 frozen registration ('margin added on top of the SAT'); duration.py SAT_MARGIN_KIM=1.25 frozen semantics. spec D4's compressed wording '25% maneuver margin' is an erratum candidate (user-level edit, out of ticket scope; recorded here per gate-review request). The window-tail pad is deliberately absent from C2: 25% of the dwell (~2-10 s) dominates the 1% model error (~0.1-0.4 s) the tail pad covers, so paying both would double-charge (spec D4 layering).
ruling_records.D07-2_settle: The settle term (2 s, Kim Table 2 measured constant) is FIXED -- never padded, never magnified: it is a measurement, not a model output.
ruling_records.F3_normalization: SUPERSEDED by amendment_20261003_ticket15. v1 read: C3/C4 budgets are normalized against the mode-library envelope: T_env_max = max over library modes of the scene-level dwell at the +-12 deg envelope edge. v1.1 reads: at each mode's OWN envelope edge (STR/SPT 45 deg, SLS 26.9 deg). budget = 1.0 remains non-degenerate and preregistered.
ruling_records.amendment_20261006_ticket31: D09-1 pad provenance corrected from Kim x3 to Kim x4 (ticket 21 had already established 4; this file's own count was never updated). The 25% margin appears in Kim 2021 at FOUR places, not the three recorded in D09-1_pad_object above: p.7 (staring spotlight, after Eq.(11): 'a margin of 25% is considered in addition to the staring spotlight mode SAT obtained from Equations (7) or (11)'), p.11 (sliding spotlight, after Eq.(24): 'a margin of 25% is considered in addition to SAT at the sliding spotlight mode obtained from Equations (19) or (24)'), p.19 (parameter statement), and p.25 (result restatement). D09-1_pad_object quotes p.11/p.19/p.25 and omits p.7; its 'x3' count and its three-quote list are therefore both incomplete. APPEND-ONLY: the original x3 text above is retained verbatim and is superseded by this record, not rewritten. Corroborating source: formula-spec v1.2 section 8.8 item 3, which made the same 2 -> 4 correction (extraction-fixture lines :334/:512/:923/:1196) and recorded that platform_kim2021.json was itself internally inconsistent on this count before being fixed. The pad semantics (multiplies the DWELL, not the maneuver; window-tail pad deliberately excluded from C2) are UNCHANGED by this amendment.

c3_energy.weights_source: DESIGN ASSUMPTION (registered, no public per-mode power figures for this platform class): finer modes carry higher average duty / data-handling overhead. Relative ordering only; the normalization makes absolute values meaningless by construction.
c3_energy.reference: T_env_max computed at each mode's own envelope edge (ticket 15): STR 1.9457 s @45deg, SLS 7.9153 s @26.9deg, SPT 10.5830 s @45deg -> max 10.5830 s (was 6.7178 s at the +-12 deg platform edge, a 1.5754x rescale)

c4_memory.formula: mem_bytes = PRF * T * N_r * b_q * 2 / 8; mem_normalized = mem_bytes / (PRF * T_env_max * N_r * b_q * 2 / 8), budget = 1.0
c4_memory.bits_convention: PER COMPONENT: I and Q each carry 3 bits after BAQ (6 bits per complex sample). TerraSAR-X samples 8-bit I/Q and compresses onboard with an 8:3 BAQ per component.
c4_memory.bits_source: TerraSAR-X BAQ design: Younis, M. (2006), 'TerraSAR-X Block Adaptive Quantizer Performance', DLR report TX-SEC-TN-MY-01 (23 pp., full text not online); corroborated by DLR elib thesis context and X-band SAR literature (web-sourced 2026-09-27, ticket 09 D09-2).
c4_memory.nr_source: DESIGN ASSUMPTION (registered): range-sample count per echo; no per-mode source exists on this platform. Mode-blind under the single production PRF (D09-4): the discrimination channel is the dwell only.
c4_memory.mode_blind_statement: Under PRF = 3630 Hz (single production operating point, ticket-08 convention) mem is a function of T only; the (mode, T, rho) signature is kept for interface stability.
